Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best way to add air conditioning to an older Pelzer home without ducts?

Ductless mini-splits, in most cases. They deliver efficient heating and cooling room by room without the cost and wall damage of retrofitting duct runs into framing never meant for them. A walkthrough determines head placement and whether one or several zones fit the floor plan.

My lights dim when the HVAC kicks on. Is that dangerous?

A brief flicker at compressor start is common, but pronounced or worsening dimming deserves diagnosis. It can indicate an overloaded panel, a weak connection, or a compressor drawing hard at startup, and each has a different fix. An evaluation identifies which is happening before it becomes a failure.

Should I replace my water heater before it fails or run it until it quits?

Age and location decide. A tank past its expected span installed above finished space is a flood planning to happen, and replacing on your schedule beats replacing on its. A newer unit with a fixable fault is a repair. The assessment prices both honestly.

Do small recurring leaks in older pipes actually mean anything?

Yes, they are data. Leaks scattered across different sections indicate the material itself aging out, and each repair buys progressively less time. A system assessment maps the condition and prices whole-line replacement against the repair pattern so the decision uses real numbers.

Do your routes cover the communities around Pelzer?

They do. Williamston, Piedmont, and Powdersville share the same dispatch, and the chat team can verify any Anderson County address.
